name: Dreadmaul Post
summary: Ogres hold Dreadmaul Post near the Dark Portal. The Dreadmaul clan raised this fortified settlement in the Blasted Lands after crossing from Draenor. Travelers face the ogres and the harsh wastes around their camp.

sections.title: Remnants of Draenor
sections.body: The Dreadmaul clan crossed into Azeroth with the Horde decades ago. Near the Dark Portal, they raised rough stone mounds and earthworks in the Blasted Lands’ red wastes. Dreadmaul Post is one of their chief outposts. From here, the ogres hold the badlands and clash with wandering beasts and travelers who approach their territory.

faq.answer: The Dreadmaul clan of ogres lives at Dreadmaul Post. They crossed from Draenor through the Dark Portal during the wars and made a lasting home in the Blasted Lands’ desolate crags.

faq.q: Why are the ogres still in the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: After the Old Horde fell and the Dark Portal was sealed, many ogres scattered across Azeroth. The Dreadmaul clan stayed near the place where they first entered and made the scarred wastes around the dormant rift their home.

faq.q: Who else wanders the area near the post?
faq.answer: Scorpid and basilisks prowl the red desert near Dreadmaul Post, along with the ogres.

angles.text: The Dreadmaul once fought beside the Old Horde, but wild clans like theirs have broken with Thrall’s new order. They regard every traveler as a hostile invader.
For Alliance scouts watching the Dark Portal, the Dreadmaul ogres are a violent, entrenched danger. Their presence makes patrols through the continent’s southern reaches harder.
